conventions.convention: Stabilizability uses A−BK and detectability uses A−LC, with witnesses over the original real or complex field. Hurwitz and Schur stability are strict.
PBH ranks are over C even for real data; the forbidden regions include Re λ=0 and |λ|=1.
Q=C* C, R=R*≻0, G=BR⁻¹B*. The CARE residual is A*X+XA−XGX+Q; the DARE residual is Q+A*XA−A*XB(R+B*XB)⁻¹B*XA−X. The adjoint is transpose over R and conjugate transpose over C.
A stabilizing DARE root is Hermitian, has R+B*XB≻0, and has Schur-stable closed loop. Singular A is allowed. The pencil is βN−αM, finite λ is [λ:1], and infinity is [1:0].

Reordering treats represented arrays and retained product factors exactly, keeps real conjugate blocks intact, and uses the right QZ factor for right deflating spaces. An ordered return concerns the represented computed pencil and transports only its unstructured residual.
SDA starts with A₀=A, G₀=BR⁻¹B*, H₀=Q; Hⱼ=f^(2^j)(0). PSD preservation and the convergence envelope concern the exact recurrence, not rounded updates.

DARE subspace separation uses the lower-oriented paired operator (Y,Z)↦(S₂₂Y−ZS₁₁,T₂₂Y−ZT₁₁) in product Frobenius norm. Stable-space identification additionally requires both leading and reciprocal-trailing Stein margins.

load_bearing.statement: For standard CARE data, continuous stabilizability and detectability give exactly one Hermitian positive-semidefinite solution X. Its closed loop is Hurwitz, and the infinite-horizon value over locally square-integrable controls is x₀*Xx₀, attained by u=−R⁻¹B*Xx. Finite cost forces x(T)*Xx(T)→0.

For standard DARE data, discrete stabilizability and detectability give exactly one Hermitian positive-semidefinite solution X. The iterates P₀=0, Pₖ₊₁=f(Pₖ) increase to X; f(Y)−f(Z)=A_c(Y)*(Y−Z)A_c(Z) for PSD Y,Z. The solution has positive R+B*XB, Schur-stable closed loop, and attains the infinite-horizon value x₀*Xx₀. Singular A is allowed.

Every admitted execution returns a declared finite status. Every committed exact swap preserves the appropriate Schur form and exchanges the adjacent block spectra, including homogeneous infinite roots. Successful ordering under the stated strict comparisons, certificates and budgets selects the represented computed form's invariant or right deflating subspace and preserves the original unstructured residual norms.
For Hermitian G,H≽0, one exact doubling step is well-defined, preserves PSD blocks, and represents f∘f. Consequently Hⱼ=f^(2^j)(0). Rounded updates have only their separately reported diagnostics.

For the stated Hermitian CARE candidate and verified inverse, residual and norm bounds, κ(r+gρ²)≤ρ and 2κgρ<1 give exactly one Hermitian root in the closed Frobenius ρ-ball. The separate Lyapunov margin makes it stabilizing; under the standard CARE hypotheses it is the unique stabilizing PSD solution.

Under the stated positive S-margin, derivative-Lipschitz and Stein-inverse bounds, κ(r+L_Dρ²/2)≤ρ and κL_Dρ<1 give exactly one Hermitian DARE root in the closed Frobenius ball. The separate Stein stability margin makes it stabilizing and, under the standard hypotheses, the unique stabilizing PSD solution.

For the stabilizing DARE solution, N[I;X]=M[I;X]A_c. The pencil is regular and has n roots strictly inside the unit disk and n outside its closure, counting infinity outside; its stable deflating graph is Ran[I;X], including when A is singular.

The reachable block decomposition characterizes horizontal PBH rank loss by the uncontrollable spectrum. A reachable pair over R or C admits any prescribed list of poles in that original field, including repetitions; empty blocks are permitted.

concerns.concern: The Definition uses the line-search list “θ_ℓ=2^(−ℓ), 0≤ℓ≤L” without declaring L as an input or specifying its admissible integer range. Its exact branch also says to “use [[alg-bartels-stewart-sylvester-equation]] to solve” but does not declare that supplier's required pivot threshold, Schur controls, sweep budgets and controller parameters or specify defaults. The finite-status lemma assumes admitted finite solver and line-search controls; making those controls explicit in this algorithm would close the operational specification gap.
